title: Adaptive Query Execution
summary: AQE can revise parts of the physical plan using runtime statistics.

blocks.text: AQE can revise parts of the physical plan using runtime statistics.

items: It can change some join strategies when runtime sizes allow it.
Skew handling can split skewed shuffle partitions.
AQE does not fix poor business logic, incorrect grain or pathological source layout.

blocks.question: Why can the final plan differ from the initial Spark plan?
blocks.answer: With Adaptive Query Execution, runtime statistics can trigger plan changes such as coalescing partitions, skew handling, or changing eligible join strategies.

provenance: Original AtlasNote V3 foundation seed authored for product integration; no third-party text or private data.
